title: Fabrikam, Inc.
sections:
Fabrikam, Inc. manufactures industrial pumps. The company has its headquarters in Montreal and production plants in Chicago and Monterrey, and employs about 4,200 people. Fabrikam is preparing a phased rollout of Microsoft 365 Copilot and wants to clean up its collaboration workloads before the rollout reaches all departments.

The IT department has three Microsoft 365 administrators. Each administrator is assigned only the workload role that matches their area (Exchange Administrator, Teams Administrator, or SharePoint Administrator).

**Licensing**

- All users have Microsoft 365 E5 licenses.
- A pilot group named CopilotPilot has 350 members who are assigned Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses.
- Fabrikam has not purchased SharePoint Advanced Management add-on licenses or Teams Premium licenses.

**Exchange Online**

- A shared mailbox named Orders (orders@fabrikam.com) is used by 14 members of the order desk. The mailbox uses 46 GB of storage, grows by about 2 GB each month, and is expected to reach 70 GB within a year. No license is assigned to the mailbox, and no archive mailbox is enabled.

**Microsoft Teams**

- A private team named Pump Design has standard channels and a private channel named Patents.
- Pump Design engineers work with engineers from Litware, Inc. The Litware engineers use work accounts in Litware's own Microsoft Entra tenant. No Microsoft Entra cross-tenant access settings are configured for the Litware tenant.
- The owners of Pump Design are assigned a Teams policy named EngineeringPolicy. In EngineeringPolicy, Create shared channels is On and Invite external users to shared channels is Off.
- Members of the board of directors are assigned a meeting policy named BoardPolicy. In BoardPolicy, the Copilot setting is On with saved transcript required and Transcription is Off.

**SharePoint Online**

- The organization-level external sharing setting for SharePoint is New and existing guests.
- A site named HR-Records (https://fabrikam.sharepoint.com/sites/HR-Records) stores salary review documents. A data access governance report shows that a folder in the site was shared with Everyone except external users. The HR site owners started a permissions review that will take about six weeks.
- HR staff use the search box inside HR-Records every day to find employee files.
- Restricted SharePoint Search has never been enabled in the tenant.

**Other**

- All Windows devices are enrolled in Microsoft Intune.
- Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 protects all mailboxes.
- The network link at the Chicago plant was upgraded last quarter.

Fabrikam identifies the following business requirements:

- **Orders mailbox:** The legal department requires that the Orders mailbox be placed on Litigation Hold. All messages must remain in the primary mailbox, because the order desk searches the primary mailbox in Outlook and must not depend on an archive.
- **Litware collaboration:** Litware engineers must collaborate with selected Pump Design engineers in a single channel of Pump Design. The Litware engineers must not have guest accounts in the Fabrikam tenant, and the other members of Pump Design must not see the channel.
- **Board meetings:** Board members must be able to use Copilot during board meetings, but no transcript of a board meeting may be retained after the meeting ends.
- **Quality site:** A new communication site named Quality (https://fabrikam.sharepoint.com/sites/Quality) must be created to publish quality bulletins to all employees. The site must not be connected to a Microsoft 365 group, must have the quality manager (qmanager@fabrikam.com) as its owner, and must have a storage quota of 2 GB. The site must be created by using a script so that it can be repeated for the other plants.
- **HR-Records:** Until the permissions review is complete, content from HR-Records must not appear in organization-wide search results or in Copilot responses. HR staff must still be able to search inside the site.

Fabrikam identifies the following technical requirements:

- Use the principle of least privilege.
- Minimize administrative effort.
- Do not change tenant-wide settings that would affect sites, teams, or mailboxes other than the ones named in a requirement.
- Existing permissions on HR-Records must not change during the review.
